records.jp: どうしたの？
いや、木の上になんか……
records.en_original: There something at the top of that tree...
records.en: There something at the top of that tree...

records.jp: 敵？
いやまさか。こんなところにヤギがいるわけ――
records.en_original: That's just not possible. A goat all the way out—
records.en: That's just not possible. A goat all the way out—

records.jp: ●カット
めぇ～
ヤギだね
そう鳴くなら間違いない
……もしかして、あそこに上って<CR>降りてこられなくなっちゃったのかな？
records.en_original: I wonder if it got up there and can't get down now...?
records.en: I wonder if it got up there and can't get down now...?

records.jp: 助けてあげましょう
●カット
めぇ～
ねえ、きらら。このヤギって……
……思い出した
村のはずれにヤギを飼っている家があった。<CR>きっとそこのヤギだと思う
records.en_original: There was a family that raised goats in the village. This must be one of them.
records.en: There was a family that raised goats in the village. This must be one of them.

records.jp: へぇ～。私、ヤギなんて初めて見たよ。<CR>これを本物って言っていいかは微妙だけど……
records.en_original: Huh. I don't think I've ever actually ever seen one before. Though who knows if its really real or not...
records.en: Huh. I don't think I've ever actually ever seen one before. Though who knows if its really real or not...

records.jp: ヤギを見たことがない！？
records.en_original: You've never seen a goat in real life before?!
records.en: You've never seen a goat in real life before?!

records.jp: ……衝撃
まったく、これだから都会育ちは
へ？
一流の淑女たるもの、ヤギの扱いも<CR>心得ていて当然なのです
records.en_original: Any country girl worth her salt knows how to take care of a goat.
records.en: Any country girl worth her salt knows how to take care of a goat.

records.jp: そんなことはないんじゃない！？
あるのです！　ね、詩帆ちゃん
ああ、ええと……そうですね……
（わたし引っ越しちゃったから、<CR>あんまりそういうのは――いや、黙っておこう）
records.en_original: (I moved when I was so young, I don't remember much of that stuff... I just won't mention that.)
records.en: (I moved when I was so young, I don't remember much of that stuff... I just won't mention that.)

records.jp: 乳しぼりもできないようじゃお嫁にいけないんだよ
records.en_original: You just aren't a woman until you learn how to milk an animal.
records.en: You just aren't a woman until you learn how to milk an animal.

records.jp: まさか、伶那さんもやったことあるの？
records.en_original: You know how to too, Rena?
records.en: You know how to too, Rena-san?

records.jp: 私はないけど
ないのかよ！！
……みんな、だらしない。<CR>わたしがお手本を見せてあげるのです
records.en_original: So sad. I'll show you all how it's done.
records.en: So sad. I'll show you all how it's done.

records.jp: こ、こころ……？
何かのスイッチ、入っちゃってますね……
records.en_original: She's like a different person all of a sudden...
records.en: She's like a different person all of a sudden...

records.jp: ほら、このようにして――
うわー……ほんとに絞ってる……。<CR>てかミルクはちゃんと白いんか……
records.en_original: Wow, she really knows how to do it... It really is white...
records.en: Wow, she really knows how to do it... It really is white...

records.jp: そこにヤギがいたらミルクを絞る。当然のことなのです
records.en_original: You see a goat, you milk it. That's just how it goes.
records.en: You see a goat, you milk it. That's just how it goes.

records.jp: そうかぁ！？
驚いた。ココロトープではミルクもとれるのか？
records.en_original: I'm surprised. Have you ever found milk in the Heartscape?
records.en: I'm surprised. Have you ever found milk in the Heartscape?

records.jp: いや、こんなのは初めて……
records.en_original: No, I've never seen anything like this.
records.en: No, I've never seen anything like this.

records.jp: ミルクがあればいろんなことができる……<CR>食生活もさらに豊かに！
records.en_original: There so much I could do with some milk... We'll be living like queens!
records.en: There so much I could do with some milk... We'll be living like queens!

records.jp: お、おお！
でも、この搾乳量だとさすがに少ないね……
records.en_original: Though I wasn't able to get very much...
records.en: Though I wasn't able to get very much...

records.jp: ど、どうすればいいんだろう？
records.en_original: I-is there anything we can do?
records.en: I-is there anything we can do?

records.jp: 餌をたくさんあげて、栄養をつけてもらうしかないね
records.en_original: All we can do is feed it and make sure it's getting enough nutrients.
records.en: All we can do is feed it and make sure it's getting enough nutrients.

草だね
めぇ～
……美味しそうな草なんて私たちには分かんないけど、<CR>試しに集めてみようか

records.en: I don't know if I know what good grass looks like, but let's see if we can't find some.
